rationale: Price is at 98.9% of today's range and within $0.01 of the session high after a strong intraday recovery from $12.89 to $13.84, meaning the risk/reward for a long is poor (minimal upside to new highs, wide stop needed) and a short against a powerful momentum move with price pressing the high is equally unattractive. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -0.96%, VIXY +5.28%), which adds macro headwind to chasing a long at the top of range, while the strong recovery momentum argues against fading it short. No clean asymmetric setup exists at this moment.
